LAN.TITLE: Games on your network

HOST.INFO: Starts a server on this computer and joins it. Friends join with your code from Invite, or find you on your network.
HOST.HOST_WORLD: They take over your quests, cleared dungeons and dead NPCs, and start next to you.
HOST.REQUIRE_MODS: Anyone missing one of your mods is told which to install.

HOST.PAUSE: The world pauses while every player is in a menu, like the inventory or the map.

HOST.RELAY_TITLE: Relay, for when your router can't be opened
HOST.RELAY_HINT: If friends outside your network can't reach you (no UPnP, or your provider shares one public address between customers), they can join through a relay: SkyrimTogetherRelay running on a machine everyone can reach. It's only used when the router port can't be opened. Leave it empty to go without.
HOST.RELAY_PASSWORD: Relay password, if it has one

GUIDELINES.PARTY: By creating a party, you sort of become the "host", aka the party leader.
GUIDELINES.PARTY_LEADER_TALK: Only the party leader can talk to quest NPCs to progress quests.
GUIDELINES.PARTY_LEADER_LOOT_QUESTITEMS: Only the party leader can loot quest items.
GUIDELINES.KEEP_PARTY_LEADER: Stick to one party leader per playthrough.
GUIDELINES.ONE_PARTY_PER_SERVER: Stick to one party per server.

ERRORS.BAD_UGRIDSTOLOAD: It seems that your Skyrim.ini file has a non-default value for 'uGridsToLoad'. THIS IS A VERY BAD IDEA, and will most likely break the mod. Please set this setting back to its default (5), or remove the Skyrim.ini file and launch Skyrim vanilla once to generate a new file. The settings 'uExterior Cell Buffer' and 'uInterior Cell Buffer' should also be left at the default setting. If you do not know how to do this, please refer to our wiki or ask on our Discord server/Reddit sub for help.
ERRORS.NON_DEFAULT_INSTALL: It seems that your installation is not purely vanilla, i.e. it has Creation Club content (Anniversary Update or otherwise) or other mods. We do NOT recommend playing with mods. We recommend that you uninstall and disable these mods (instructions can be found on the wiki). For the best experience, you should have the following mod list: Skyrim.esm Update.esm Dawnguard.esm HearthFires.esm Dragonborn.esm _ResourcePack.esl SkyrimTogether.esp SkyrimTogetherQuestPatches.esp
ERRORS.WRONG_VERSION_PLUS_UPDATE_YOU: This game runs Skyrim Together Plus {{expectedVersion}} and you have {{version}}, which is older. Everyone needs the same version: update from the Plus release page to join.
ERRORS.WRONG_VERSION_PLUS_UPDATE_HOST: This game runs Skyrim Together Plus {{expectedVersion}}, which is older than yours ({{version}}). Everyone needs the same version: ask the host to update from the Plus release page, or install {{expectedVersion}} from it.
